name: Olsera to PostgreSQL Sync Workflow - Grandivo

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO products (
  olsera_id, 
  name, 
  sku, 
  price, 
  buy_price, 
  stock, 
  weight, 
  description, 
  category, 
  brand, 
  image_url, 
  is_active, 
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.olsera_id }}',
  '{{ $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.sku.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.price }},
  {{ $json.buy_price }},
  {{ $json.stock }},
  {{ $json.weight }},
  '{{ $json.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.brand.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.image_url.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.is_active }},
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (olsera_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  sku = EXCLUDED.sku,
  price = EXCLUDED.price,
  buy_price = EXCLUDED.buy_price,
  stock = EXCLUDED.stock,
  weight = EXCLUDED.weight,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  brand = EXCLUDED.brand,
  image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  updated_at = NOW();
